projectDescription: An open protocol and sample framework for standardized agent-to-agent interoperability, enabling AI agents built with any framework or language to communicate, delegate tasks, and collaborate via JSON-RPC over HTTP.
keyFeatures: Standardized JSON-RPC over HTTP protocol for agent-to-agent communication
AgentCard discovery mechanism for publishing agent capabilities and skills
Streaming support via Server-Sent Events for real-time task updates
Multi-turn conversational task management with state lifecycle (submitted, working, input-required, completed, canceled, failed)
Multi-modal message parts: text, file, and data
Protocol extensions: AGP routing, Secure Passport, Timestamp, Traceability
Multi-language SDKs: Python, Go, Java, JavaScript, .NET, Rust
Support for popular AI frameworks: LangGraph, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, Google ADK, LlamaIndex, Marvin
publicApiSurface: AgentCard — agent identity and capability discovery document
AgentSkill — declares input/output modes and tags for a skill
AgentCapabilities — flags for streaming and extended card support
AgentExecutor.cancel(context, event_queue) — cancels a running task
RequestContext — provides current task and message to the executor
DefaultRequestHandler — wires executor, task store, and agent card
InMemoryTaskStore — in-memory implementation of the task store
create_jsonrpc_routes() — Starlette routes for message/send and message/stream
message/send — JSON-RPC method for synchronous task execution
message/stream — JSON-RPC method for streaming task execution (SSE)
tasks/get — JSON-RPC method to retrieve a task by ID
tasks/cancel — JSON-RPC method to cancel a running task
